preview.text: Malaysia faces Hong Kong, China in a T20 match at Selangor Turf Club where the usual first-innings score in the 7 recorded T20 matches is 144. Hong Kong, China won the toss and chose to bat first. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to a 88 per cent chance of rain and about 28 degrees.

summary.text: Hong Kong, China scored 140-5 in their innings with Zeeshan Ali top-scoring with 48 off 38 balls, while Vijay Unni took 3 for 16 for MLY. In response, MLY reached 72-5 as Syed Aziz Mubarak made 40 off 21 balls and Ayush Shukla claimed 3 for 24, resulting in a 7-run victory by the DLS method for Hong Kong, China.
